entries.zh: 俸禄，官吏受于朝廷的禄米俸给（王俸）
entries.en: stipend paid by the king; official emolument
entries.notes: 仅音调记号 T99（污损难辨）触发低置信；祿/loy/Salario del Rey 三栏互证清晰，字义本身可靠

entries.zh: 贡士，乡试中式、贡入京师的士人（由朝廷供给廪给）
entries.en: tribute scholar sent up to the capital for the metropolitan examination; stipendiary of the crown

entries.zh: 钱粮，上缴朝廷的钱谷赋税；亦指钱粮俸给
entries.en: revenue in money and grain, taxes due the crown; stipend paid in cash and grain

entries.zh: 俸粮，官吏俸给中的粮米
entries.en: grain allowance of a mandarin; salary paid in grain

entries.zh: 补廪，增生递补廪生缺额、开始支领官廪
entries.en: promotion to a stipend place in the government school; to fill a stipended-student vacancy
to grant or pay a stipend
stipend and emoluments of an official
entries.notes: 罗马字栏作 Log. hong log.，首词当为禄之重出，拼写与第1条 loy 略异

entries.zh: 给粮，发放口粮、粮饷（供士兵等食用）
entries.en: to issue rations or a grain allowance (e.g. to soldiers)
entries.notes: 西语栏标 [疑]，vy 缩写两读（soldado/Sotados）待考；汉字给粮与闽南音明确

entries.zh: 廪生，支领官府廪米的生员
entries.en: stipended student of the government school, holding the crown allowance

entries.zh: 廪膳，官府供给生员的廪米膳食
entries.en: official grain allowance granted to scholars; boarding stipend

entries.zh: 工食，雇工仆役的工钱与伙食；兼收工喫一形
entries.en: wages and board of a servant or hired laborer
entries.notes: 西语 vy siruen 之 vy 为缩写（推为 sirvien(te) 仆役）；罗马字兼录 cong sit / cong chia 两形

entries.zh: 盐盒，盛盐的盒子（餐桌盐罐）
盐课司，掌盐税盐政的官署
entries.en: salt-tax office; bureau administering the salt monopoly

entries.zh: 盐漏，盐场滤盐漏盐的漏具（漏筛）
entries.en: salt strainer or funnel used at the salt works
entries.notes: 鹽漏所指器物据字面推断，西语词头仅泛作盐场，四栏互证不足

entries.zh: 盐露，盐埕晒制中凝结渗出的卤露（由此提得净盐）
entries.en: salt dew, brine beads on the pans from which refined salt is made
entries.notes: 西语明言能提纯盐之盐场；鹽露为晒盐工艺专名，据字面与工序推断
西语词头似残句例句（salio a cosa, como baca, perxa ca.），与風不能互证；释义据汉字与闽南音 hong
